name: Grand Hyatt Deer Valley
positioning: Slopeside mountain resort and flagship hotel of Deer Valley East Village near Park City, Utah, overlooking Jordanelle Reservoir
best_for: Skiers who want slopeside access at Deer Valley
Families wanting a game lounge and family activities

facts.text: The hotel is the flagship hotel of Deer Valley East Village, near Park City.
Rooms have a modern mountain style where contemporary design meets rustic charm.
Room perks include fireplaces, kitchenettes and balcony views of Jordanelle Reservoir.
The hotel's one-, two- and three-bedroom private residences have panoramic views of the Jordanelle Reservoir.
Agaci Spa + Wellness is rooted in the restorative beauty of the Wasatch Mountains.
The spa has the Ember Oasis dry heat sauna.
The Nexus Lounge and Arcade has PS5 and Xbox gaming systems, air hockey, ping pong, vintage arcade games and board games.
Family activities include creative workshops, mountain stories, family movies, games and Saturday s'mores.
Sushi by Scratch Restaurants brings Chef Phillip Frankland Lee's omakase experience to the hotel.
The meeting and event space has floor-to-ceiling windows and includes one of Park City's largest ballrooms.
There is a dedicated dog run on the property.
The hotel is less than 45 minutes by car from Salt Lake City airport.

highlights.text: The hotel offers slopeside access to skiing and easy access to Jordanelle Reservoir for fishing and paddleboarding.
Rooms have large windows with views of Jordanelle Reservoir and the surrounding mountains.
The heated outdoor pool and hot tubs are open year-round, surrounded by the alpine landscape.
The spa's signature Mountain Soul Ritual for couples features a foot soak, body polish and synchronized massage.
On-site ski rentals with Ski Butlers include expert fittings, with rentals delivered to your room.

considerations.text: The hotel sits on the opposite side of the mountain from downtown Park City, overlooking the Jordanelle Reservoir.
Downtown Park City is a 15 to 20 minute drive from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury mountain resort positioning.
